name: Chaos na Karada ~ Futari no Futanari Kakuchouki
original_name: Chaosなカラダ～ふたりのふたなり拡張記
source:
In a near future.
To raise the low birthrate, people come up with a possible solution: make hermaphrodite persons so that they can take both roles in the reproduction system.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE054251.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
近未来，为扭转低生育率，人们想出一个方案：制造同时拥有两套生殖器官的双性人，使其能在繁衍过程中同时承担男女双方的角色。

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE054251.html]DLsite English[/url]]
